input_evidence.summary: #9344 [Automation] native-image run fails for io.netty:netty-transport-native-unix-common:4.1.79.Final; label=fails-native-image-run; body_chars=8015

risks: The log excerpt is truncated before the actual native-image run failure, so the failing operation is unknown. Diagnose it from a local run of the reproducer.

The metadata list shows mixed Netty versions (netty-buffer and netty-transport at 4.1.80.Final, netty-common and netty-resolver at 4.1.79.Final). A version mismatch between these modules may be the cause, but this is unverified.

The library uses JNI native code loaded through NativeLibraryLoader, so a missing JNI or resource entry is possible. That can be repaired with reachability metadata, so it does not make the version unsupportable.
libraryPreparationPreflight.summary: The issue excerpt never shows the failing operation, and nothing in it points to a missing dependency, Docker image or system property. The log shows a native image that built successfully (26.68MB). netty-transport-native-unix-common is a thin JNI/unix-socket helper whose existing 4.1.57.Final tests need no extra setup.
